Commentary.Commentary: Back for the run chase! The men concerned have emerged out from the dressing room. Zimbabwe would be eyeing a quick start in the Powerplay. Out come their openers, Tarisai Musakanda and Tinashe Kamunhukamwe. The young and promising fast bowler, Naveen-ul-Haq, to kick-off proceedings for Afghanistan with the ball. Here we go...

Right then. 199 to win. Not going to be easy for Zimbabwe to chase this down but the pitch seems to be good for batting, so they can give it a shot. The hosts will be looking to bowl, as well as they have batted and grab the game by the scruff of the throat. An exciting second essay awaits. Join us shortly for the run chase.

The man of the moment, Rahmanullah Gurbaz is in for a quick chat! He starts by saying that it was a plan from them to attack at the start. Shares that the pitch is good for batting, he wanted to watch some balls before going for his shots. Adds that he got a debut hundred in ODIs and it was a good experience for him and every time he wants to do good for his team. Tells that they have very good bowlers in their ranks and hopes to defend the total.

The less we talk about Zimbabwe's bowling, the better. They were abysmal for most of their bowling innings but have done slightly well to bring things back to their favour, towards the end of the innings, to restrict the Afghans to a total of under 200. No noticeable name pops out, when you think about their bowling, as they were all tonked around the ground. They will be hoping for a better show, with the bat now.

The start by the 'hosts' was just the start that you need in a T20I game. The openers came out with intent, as Gurbaz and Janat were not at all holding back. They added 80 runs in a very quick manner and it looked like there would be no stopping them. Janat then fell and the skipper, Afghan, and Gurbaz motored along. Gurbaz was looking set to reach his hundred but sadly for him, he missed out too. Afghan did not stop and went onto score his 4th fifty in T20Is. All of their combined efforts have seen them end up with a good total. They might have been looking at the 215-220 score, but will be happy with this total too.

An excellent batting effort from Afghanistan has seen them end on a very strong total. At the toss, Sean Williams wanted to restrict Afghanistan to a total of around 150-160, but his plans have been thrown out the window as Afghanistan have ended up with a total of 198. Top stuff!

Swing and a miss! Brilliant finish to the over by Blessing. Angles across a back of a length delivery outside off, Zadran swings and misses. 13 from the over but Afghanistan have been stopped inside 200.
The next batsman walks out. Usman Ghani it is.

OUT! Caught behind! Clever change in pace by Blessing Muzarabani. He lands it full and wide outside off, Rashid once again attempts for a fancy big shot and swings his bat at it. This time though the ball arrives late to take the top edge. It flies in the air and Richmond Mutumbami grabs it easily behind the wickets.
SIX! Rashid brings out the helicopter shot. Fuller and in the zone around off, Khan swings his bat like a sword and dismisses it behind the bowler's head.

OUT! Afghan holes out! But he has already done the damage. Attempts to go downtown and clear long on but fails to get the desired distance. Sikandar Raza settles underneath it near the fence and takes a well-judged catch. Najibullah Zadran is in next but Rashid will be on strike.

SIX! Fifty for Asghar, off 37 balls. Continues with his good form. Picks the slower one early, it's on the shorter side and the Afghanistan skipper clobbers it into the grassy banks at deep mid-wicket. His 4th fifty in T20Is!
Very full in length on off, Rashid hangs back and drags it to wide long on for a run.
Rashid Khan is sent up the order to do some fireworks in the final over.

OUT! CAUGHT! Finishes a very good over with the big wicket at this stage as Nabi can be very lethal with the bat! Short ball outside off, Nabi looks to tonk it over long off but does not middle it and ends up hitting it straight to long off, where Brandon Mavuta takes an easy catch.
Brilliant bowling, this. Fires a yorker wide outside the off stump, Afghan has to reach out for it and he plays it to deep point for a single.
Short ball outside off, Nabi pulls it to mid-wicket for a single.
Can Richard Ngarava finish his last over well?
This is more like it. Richard Ngarava fires a yorker outside off and Afghan gets an inside edge to short fine leg. Only a run.
FOUR! This is innovative batting by the skipper, goes across the line to length ball on the stumps and scoops it behind the keeper for a boundary.
Length ball outside off, Afghan looks to smack it through the off side but misses the shot.

Another slower ball outside off, Nabi looks to slam this one to the on side but fails to get bat on the ball again. A couple of good balls to end another tidy over, 6 from it, 12 in the last two at the death is a great effort.
Off pace, outside off yet again, Nabi's attempt to slog does not reap any rewards.
Full on off, whipped to deep mid-wicket for one.

FOUR! Not timed perfectly but will still be a boundary. Short, around off, Asghar Afghan pulls this one to the mid-wicket region, where Wesley Madhevere runs to his right but does not reach on time. The ball bounces once and goes past the rope.
Slowish length ball outside off, AA goes on his knees, looking for the big shot to the leg side. The skipper misses though.
Fuller and outside off, Nabi slaps it back towards the bowler, who half-stops this one and deflects it towards mid on. The batters run across and complete the single.
Quicker ball on the stumps. Nabi pushes it to long on to keep the strike. Another good over for Burl, only 6 off it. He has pulled things back from his end, at least.
Loopy delivery on the pads as Afghan tucks it short fine for a single.
Quicker delivery outside off, Afghan cuts it off the back foot to covers.
Flatter ball around off and Nabi pushes it through covers for a run.
Flighted ball outside off, Afghan pushes it to long on for a run.
Burl gets away with poor delivery this time. It is a short ball down the leg side, Afghan pulls towards short fine leg, who puts in a dive to save and saves two runs as the batters collect a couple.
4 overs left in the innings. The leggie to continue...
Pitches it up and wide outside off, Asghar rockets his drive to deep cover for a run. 10 from the over, Tiripano finishes his 4-over spell, went for 46.
Slower one, shortish and on off, Nabi picks it and turns it behind square leg for one.
Back of a length delivery wide outside off, Asghar slaps it down to long off and rotates the strike.
Wide! Tiripano feels the heat and slips a length ball well wide outside off, Afghan leaves it alone.

FOUR! Excellent pick-up shot from the Afghanistan skipper. Tiripano is feeding the batsman in his zone, short and on middle, Afghan is ready on the back foot and spanks it down to long leg for a boundary.
Donald goes short again, keeps it on middle and leg, Nabi eases his pull shot down to deep backward square leg for a run.

DROPPED! Yet another one put down! Slower delivery, short and wide outside off, Afghan tries to smash it across the line but edges it behind. Mutumbami dives across to his right, stretches his hand out but it doesn't stick. The ball deflects behind and they take a run.
Fuller delivery around off and eased through the covers. Afghan to keep the strike. End of a successful over by Ryan. Just 2 runs off it as well.
Flatter ball outside off, Afghan looks to cut it away but is beaten.
Drifts on his pads this time. Bowls a flatter ball on his pads and Nabi clips it away to square leg for a single.
Flatter ball outside off and it is cut straight to covers.
No shortage of power-hitters in the Afghanistan ranks. They keep on coming! President is here. Mohammad Nabi's turn to flex his muscles.

OUT! TAKEN! No century in store for Gurbaz. Heartbreaking as he was looking set for that magical three-number score. A wicket against the run of play for Burl. He bowls a loopy delivery on middle and off as Rahmanullah Gurbaz comes down the track looking to slog it away to the on side. Unluckily for him, it takes the leading edge and the ball loops up in the air towards the point region. Donald Tiripano is the fielder there and the catch is taken. No century but that doesn't take away the fact that he was simply ruthless and amazing. Terrorized the Zimbabwean bowlers with his extraordinary onslaught.
A rare dot ball for Zimbabwe. Flighted ball on the stumps and defended of the front foot.
It's appearing next to impossible for Zimbabwe to stop the flow of runs. Yet another change in bowling now, Ryan Burl is back into the attack. Went for 16 in his opening over.

FOUR! The third one in the over and there is no respite in store for Zimbabwe. They are being hammered here. Another full toss, outside off, slammed through covers and another boundary. 17 from this one.
Fuller, on middle, heaved to deep mid-wicket. This single brings up the 150 for the Afghans.
Around off, length, sliced to deep point for one.

FOUR! Looks like the skipper does not want his youngster, Gurbaz to hog all the limelight. He wants some on him too. This is a full toss outside off, Asghar Afghan bunts this one down the ground and it races away to the long off rope.
WIDE. Sprays this one way outside off again. Richard is too scared to bowl it in the half of the batsman.
Off pace ball outside off, Afghan looks to swing. But gets done by the lack of pace. Misses.
WIDE. Another one. Trying to keep it away from the hitting arc of Afghan but Richard is missing out here. Full and wide outside off again, left alone. Wide signalled.
WIDE. Way outside off, AA leaves.

FOUR! Powerful stroke from the skipper. Shortish, slightly around the off pole, Asghar Afghan pulls this one through mid-wicket and the fielder at long on, runs to his right, but is not able to stop the ball from crossing the rope.
Richard Ngarava is back on. 1/19 in his 2 overs so far. 211 is the projected score if Afghanistan continue with the current rate.
Excellent over under these circumstances. Full delivery and Gurbaz hits it to the left of the bowler but does not find the gap. A dot ball to finish
Excellent fielding at long off! Loopy delivery wide outside off and Afghan smacks it straight down the ground. Raza at long off dives to his right to save a certain boundary. One.
2 Wides! Fires this one down the leg side, Rahmanullah Gurbaz looks to sweep it away but misses the shot. A fumble by the keeper means that they cross over for a run.
This is excellent bowling by Mavuta. Bowls a flighted ball on the stumps and Gurbaz defends it back to the bowler.
Flighted ball on off and RG defends this off the front foot.
He got lucky there! This was a short ball down the leg side and Afghan only manages to pull it to short fine.
Beaten! Bowls a flighted ball outside off and gets the ball to turn. Afghan looks to play it through the off side but the ball whizzes past his bat.
Shortish and on middle, tucked through mid-wicket for one run. 16 off Ryan's first.
On off, driven through covers for one. There was a call for two but they had to settle for just one.

SIX! My god! Somebody, please call 911! Gurbaz is committing a crime here, you cannot be THIS lethal with the bat! Floated around off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz skips down the track and whacks this one over covers. The 50-run stand also is up now.
Floated on off, worked to the off side for a single.
Around off, full, floated, worked to deep cover for one.
Gurbaz welcomes Burl into the bowling attack with a biggie. Ryan gifts a nice loopy delivery around off to RG, who accepts this gift gleefully and bangs this one down the ground. Moves to 78 now.
Bowling change. Ryan Burl to bowl his leggies.
Flighted ball around off, Afghan defends this on the off side. 9 from Mavuta's first.
Afghan would be disappointed with that. It was a full toss wide outside off, Afghan looks to smack it through the off side but does not get his bat on it.
Good follow-up delivery by Mavuta, fuller delivery on the stumps and Gurbaz punches it to long on for a single. Moves to 72 off 35 balls.
SIX! This is massive! Mavuta bowls a flighted delivery on leg and Gurbaz slog sweeps this over square leg for a maximum.
Loopy ball on his pads, Gurbaz nudges it short fine leg.
Flighted ball on his pads and it's tucked away to square leg for a single.
Wide! Starts off with wide down the leg side, Afghan looks to sweep it away but misses.

Afsar Zazai comes up for a quick chat near the boundary line. Says that things are good so far as they have crossed 100 in 10 overs. Tells that they have good hitters to come and they will be targeting 200. Hopes that Gurbaz will get a century and shares that they have played here many times in the past and know the conditions. Also adds that they are not bothered whether they will bowl first or bat. Meanwhile, there is a change in bowling, Brandon Mavuta to have a go now.
19 from the over! On the middle pole, fuller, worked to the on side for a single. The 'hosts' are at 108/1 at the halfway mark.
SIX! 100 up for Afghanistan! Terrific shot from the skipper. A low full toss on the pads, Asghar Afghan picks this one up and deposits this over the fence at deep square leg.
WIDE. Down the leg side, Afghan lets it be.

FOUR LEG BYES! When it is not your day, it is JUST NOT YOUR DAY! Everything going in the way of Afghanistan here! Back of a length, on the pads, Afghan looks to pull but misses. The ball takes the pad and goes to the fine leg fence, past the diving keeper.
Fuller, on the pads, tucked through square leg for a single.
Around off, length, tapped to point.

SIX! Gurbaz is looking at a big score, based on the way he is playing here. Shortish, slightly slow, around off, Gurbaz swivels and pulls this one behind square on the leg side. The umpires check once to confirm if it is a six or four and decide that it is a biggie after getting assistance from the upstairs.
Change in bowling. Donald Tiripano is getting ready to bowl his third over. 2-0-21-0 are his figures so far.
Flatter delivery on his legs, Gurbaz tucks it away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! This is massive from Gurbaz! Raza comes round the wicket and bowls a flatter delivery right in his slot. Gurbaz clears his front leg and deposits this over long on for a maximum.
Full delivery outside off and Afghan drives it to deep cover for a single.
Loopy delivery outside off, Afghan punches it to covers.
Flighted ball around off, Afghan plays it back to the bowler.
Flatter ball outside off, Gurbaz punches this to long off to rotate the strike.
Asghar Afghan is the new batsman. There is a change in bowling as well. Sikandar Raza is back on to bowl. He opened the attack for Zimbabwe and conceded just 7 runs.

OUT! CAUGHT! There it is! There is the breakthrough that the Zimbabweans were waiting for. It has come after some time and even though Janat walks back, he should be happy with his contribution with the blade, to give Afghanistan a good platform! Slightly short and outside off, going across the right-hander, as Karim Janat looks to slam this one. Only manages an outside edge due to the extra bounce and it goes to the keeper, Richmond Mutumbami, who takes it on the second attempt. The 80-run opening stand is broken and Zimbabwe would take this opportunity to regroup.
FIFTY FOR RAHMANULLAH GURBAZ, off just 26 balls! His 3rd in T20I cricket and he has started off in a cracking manner. He will be looking to continue here. On the pads, flicked to square leg for one.
Good length around off, punched to deep cover for one run.
Around off, good length, stroked to point and the call from Gurbaz, for the single, is 'WAIT, WAITTTT'.
Short of a length, on the body, RG hops and tucks this one through square leg for a single.
Around off, lack of pace is evident again, length, Janat works this one to deep cover for one.
Bowling change. Richard Ngarava is back to bowl his second over. He went for 15 in his over which started the charge from Afghanistan.
Length ball outside off, Janat punches it down the ground to long on and keeps the strike. 10 from the one, runs continue to flow.
Length ball around off, Gurbaz plays it down the ground towards mid on for a run.
Poor fielding at point. Short of a length outside off, Janat plays it towards the point fielder who fumbles and they run a single.
WIDE! He has got to change his line. Length ball down the leg side.
Short delivery on the stumps and Janat ducks under it.
Back of a length on off and played with soft hands to covers for a single.
FOUR! GEEZ! THAT WAS POWERFUL! Short of a length ball wide outside off and Gurbaz cuts it fiercely through point. The ball runs away to the ropes.
WIDE! Starts off with a wide delivery down the leg side.
Donald Tiripano is summoned into the attack again. Went for 11 in his opening over.
Around off, pushed to point. Afghanistan are on a roll here, they are at 66/0 at the end of the Powerplay. At this rate, 200 will be easily achieved.
Fuller and outside off, KJ lofts this one over mid off. A couple this time, by the time the man in the deep can run and clean up.
On middle, worked to the leg side.
FOUR! WHAM! How many times have we seen this? A catch being dropped and a boundary to follow that ball up. Outside off, length, lofted over the backward point region for a boundary.

IN THE AIR...SPILLED! Oh my god! How could you have dropped that? It is also the catch of Gurbaz. Wesley Madhevere is having a horror tour. Not the best in the Test series and he drops this one too. Shortish around off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz pulls it to the deep mid-wicket region and Wesley Madhevere takes it and then the ball pops out of his hands on this occasion. A single.
Back of a length ball on off, Janat tucks this one through mid-wicket for a quick single.
Flighted delivery outside off, Janant plays it through the off side to keep the strike. 14 runs off Williams' first over.
This is better bowling by Williams. Shortens his length a bit and Janat defends this of the front foot.
FOUR! Now Janat gets going. Flatter delivery outside of and Janat pierces it through covers for a boundary.
FOUR! This is poor bowling by the skipper, Flighted delivery outside off and Janat lofts this one over covers for a four.
Length ball outside off and Gurbaz plays it down the ground, to long on, for a single.
FOUR! Gurbaz is on fire here! Flatter delivery outside off and he punches this past the man at cover for a boundary.
44 in the first 4 and the skipper Sean Williams brings himself into the attack.
Moves leg side and Donald follows him. Gurbaz pulls this one to deep mid-wicket for a single. 11 off this one.

On middle, good length, pushed to mid-wicket. Another slower delivery, this. So, pace off the ball is the way to go on this surface. Hopefully, the Zimbabweans will pass over the message to each other.
SWING AND A MISS! Good thinking by Donald. Bowls an off pace ball outside off, takes weeks to arrive, Gurbaz is early into the pull and misses.

FOUR! Rahmanullah Gurbaz is wreaking havoc right now. Moves to 35 off just 15 balls. Racing away towards his fifty here. Outside off, length, slapped away over backward point for a boundary. A brilliant start by Afghanistan here!
On a good length and on off, Gurbaz lifts this one over the mid-wicket region for a couple of runs. He is going after every iota of width in his zone.
FOUR! Gurbaz is on a roll. On a good length, around off, Gurbaz delicately guides this one through the short third man region. A boundary results.

In the air...safe! Back of a length and on middle, Janat flicks this one uppish over the backward square leg region. The man from short 45 races and pulls the ball back before the ropes. Two taken. 11 from the over, 26 in the last two, Afghanistan are off to a flying start.
On a good length and around off, driven, but straight to the cover fielder.
Outside off, worked to third man for a single.
FOUR! SLAM! On a length, outside off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz backs away and chops this one nicely through backward point and the ball speeds away to the ropes, past the diving fielder there.
WIDE. Slipped down the leg side, left alone.

Overthrows and a single now. On a good length around off, Karim taps this one to the slip cordon, and the fielder there collects and has a shy at the non-striker's end and hits too. But the batter was in. There was no one backing up and the batters sneak in a run.
Blessing starts off with a back of a length ball outside off, Janat slams this one through point for a couple of runs.
Bowling change. Blessing Muzarabani to bowl now.
A length ball on middle and off, it's pushed gently towards point and the call is for wait. Dot to end the over, 15 off it.
Excellent delivery, on a good length and close to off, angling away, Rahmanullah stays back and pushes it with an angled bat to point.

SIX! This one has also gone the distance! Ngarava overcompensates with his length and Gurbaz does well to anticipate it. He turns on the back foot and pulls the short delivery mightily over square leg. Great connection, there is a boundary rider but he is a mere spectator.

SIX! No half measures there! It's a humongous strike! Richard overpitches in his attempt to get some movement but it's right in the arc for the batsman, Gurbaz muscles it over long on for a maximum. Clean strike.
Wide! Slips a length ball down the leg side, probably attempting an inswinger from the middle stump line, Gurbaz tries to flick but misses.
AERIAL BUT SAFE! Fuller in length and wide outside off, Gurbaz throws his bat at it and gets it away off the outer half. The ball clears the infield at extra cover and they collect a couple of runs.
Back of a length ball around off, angling away with extra bounce, Gurbaz drops his wrists and allows it through.
Who will bowl from the other end? Richard Ngarava to run in from the opposite end. There is a slip in place for the left-arm pacer.
On middle, worked to the off side for one. 7 off the first one.

EDGY FOUR! Not what Gurbaz was looking to do, but he will take it. Floated outside off, Gurbaz swings his blade at this but only manages a get an outside edge, which goes to the third man region for a boundary.
Janat is underway too! On middle, slightly short, Karim nurdles this one to mid-wicket for a single.
Around off, floated, Janat pushes this one to covers.
Afghanistan and Rahmanullah Gurbaz are underway here. Shortish and on middle, nudged towards the mid on region for a single.
PLAY AND A MISS! Raza starts off with a flighted ball outside off, Gurbaz thinks about having a poke but fails to get bat on ball. No spin there with the new nut as it skids off the surface.

We are all in readiness for the action to begin. The Zimbabwean players spread out on the field and the Afghan openers, Karim Janat and Rahmanullah Gurbaz make their way out too. Spin to start off as Sikandar Raza is getting ready to bowl now. Here he comes...
Time for the National Anthems! Both the teams are out in the middle and first, it will be Zimbabwe's turn, followed by Afghanistan's.

Asghar Afghan, the skipper of Afghanistan, says that he would have anyway batted first. Shares that the pitch is looking good and they would look to put up a good total and put Zimbabwe under pressure. Tells that they have played well in this format and they have good experience in the squad.

Sean Williams, the Zimbabwe skipper, says that looking at the par scores and the win rates in the previous games, the team bowling first has won more and they have 3 seamers and he is backing them to do well here. Adds that this is a good opportunity for their seamers to come and perform here. Opines that 150 to 160 would be a good score and anything above that, will be hard. Says that they have some new faces in the team and they also have some power-hitters in their team.

Pitch report - Ahmed Raza is doing the pitch report. He says that the same pitch is being used for this match that was used for the first Test match but it has no grass left over it. Tells that it's nicely rolled and he reckons that a total of 160 will be par.

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Tarisai Musakanda, Tinashe Kamunhukamwe, Sean Williams (C), Wesley Madhevere, Sikandar Raza, Richmond Mutumbami (WK), Ryan Burl, Donald Tiripano, Brandon Mavuta, Blessing Muzarabani, Richard Ngarava.

Afghanistan (Playing XI) - Rahmanullah Gurbaz (WK), Karim Janat, Usman Ghani, Hashmatullah Shahidi, Asghar Afghan (C), Najibullah Zadran, Mohammad Nabi, Rashid Khan, Amir Hamza, Naveen-ul-Haq, Farid Malik.

Toss time in Abu Dhabi! Both the captains are out in the middle, Afghanistan are the designated home team so Asghar Afghan flips the coin, Sean Williams calls it correctly and ZIMBABWE ELECT TO FIELD!

Hello and a warm welcome to the first T20I between Afghanistan and Zimbabwe. After the red-ball series, which was shared between both of these sides, now they move on to the white-ball series, which will be a 3-game T20I series and this trophy is up for grabs now. The 'hosts' who played their last T20I series against Ireland, won the series 2-1 and will be looking to continue their momentum. Zimbabwe, on the other hand, were handed a whitewash by Pakistan and will want to redeem themselves, by winning this game, and then going on to win the series. A cracking encounter is on the cards. Stay tuned with us for the toss and the team news...
